title: Actionable Agronomic Guidance
subtitle: Scientific crop protection protocols organized by precipitation timing windows.

default_before.title: Clear Peripheral Drainage Channels
default_before.action: Remove silt and debris from field bund outlets to accelerate water discharge before showers intensify.
default_before.reason: Prevents initial flash water ponding in low-lying field zones.

default_during.title: Monitor Field Drainage Flow
default_during.action: Ensure bund spillways remain unobstructed and avoid traversing deeply saturated fields.
default_during.reason: Prevents soil compaction and bund breaches.

default_after.title: Foliar Spray of 1% Potassium Nitrate (KNO3)
default_after.action: Apply once stagnant water recedes to boost plant vigor and stimulate root respiration.
default_after.reason: Overcomes temporary anaerobic root stress caused by waterlogging.
